mapper.insert: INSERT INTO evaluation_notes (application_id, author_id, content, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{applicationId}, #{authorId}, #{content}, #{createdAt}, #{createdAt}, #{createdBy}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT id, application_id, author_id, content, created_at, created_by FROM evaluation_notes WHERE application_id = #{applicationId} AND is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
